notes: 02: metadata service collects only title+description (metadata-parser.server.ts); no favicon or preview image. 04: editor updates url/title/description/tags but there is no note field in schema/validation. 07: card shows title/description/tags but no favicon (only a first-letter badge). 12: search covers title/url/description/tags but there is no note field to search. 14: no #tag search syntax; tag filtering is only a dropdown param. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing; query is a literal LIKE substring. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag in schema or UI. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 22: sort is hardcoded to createdAt desc; no sort-key option. 23: no markdown note storage or rendering. 24-25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive support. 26-28: no archived flag or archive views; only permanent delete. 29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user display settings (font size/default sort/displayed items).
